summary: EMI Calculator result-panel redesign fully validated on desktop 1920, iPad 820 and mobile 390. Grey panel #E7E5DE renders on top of dark page body (rgb(10,10,10)); Monthly EMI is the largest text (60px) vs Total (24px) vs Principal/Interest (20px); all default values match the spec exactly (₹43,391 / ₹50,00,000 / ₹54,13,879 / ₹1,04,13,879). Real-time updates verified (25L→₹21,696; rate preset 9% recalculates; months toggle sets 240). Minimum loan clamps to ₹1,00,000 correctly. WhatsApp share href contains Monthly EMI text. iPad 820px shows inputs and grey panel truly side-by-side (inputs right=461, panel left=485). Mobile 390 has no horizontal overflow and panel is readable. All ink text colours (rgb(10,10,10) and 0.5-0.9 alpha) provide strong contrast on the light grey panel. Regression: /projects/my-dream-skylark project-finance still present; finance-partners section still renders below the calculator.
critical_code_review_comments: EmiCalculator.jsx is well-structured (~350 lines); EMI useMemo formula unchanged and correct.
SliderField numeric input onChange uses clamp on parseFloat — 50000 correctly snaps to 100000 min.
WhatsApp share URL encodes newline-joined summary correctly; includes Monthly EMI line.
